snippet.title: Little One Trailer
snippet.description:
Little One is a side-scrolling RPG where you take the role of Seph, an artistically inclined child exploring a strange and unusual world in search of food for their dog. All the while meeting peculiar residents, making friends, and fighting off nightmarish foes along the way.

Available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819680/Little_One/
